sql.trim: id as id, name as name, description as description, status as status, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime, delete as delete, internal as internal, workspace_id as workspaceId, menu_keys as menuKeys, is_admin as isAdmin

mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET "delete"= true where id = #{id} and internal = false
mapper.delete: delete from sys_user_roles where user_id = #{id} and type = 'ADFS'
mapper.select: with recursive tmp as (select mr.parent_id from menu_router mr, sys_role_menu srm where mr.id = srm.menu_id and srm.checked = true and srm.role_id = #{id} union all select mr.parent_id from menu_router mr, tmp where mr.id = tmp.parent_id and mr.parent_id is not null) select mr.menu_key as menuKey, mr.id as menuId, mr.parent_id as parentId, COALESCE(mr."level", 0) as level, srm.checked, mr.icon, mr.show, mr."rank" from sys_role_menu srm, menu_router mr where (srm.menu_id in (select parent_id from tmp) or srm.checked = true) and srm.menu_id = mr.id and srm.role_id = #{id}

select
from sys_role
status = true and delete = false
order by create_time desc

select sr.id, sr."name", sr.workspace_id, sr.menu_keys, sr.is_admin from sys_role sr left join sys_user_roles sur on sur.role_id = sr.id and type = #{type} where delete = false and status = true
and sur.user_id = '${id}'

select r.read_write as readAndWrite, menu.id as menuId, menu.*, menu.is_menu as menuFlag from menu_router as menu left join (select srm.menu_id, srm.read_write from sys_role_menu srm where srm.role_id = #{roleId}) as r on menu.id = r.menu_id order by id

select r.checked, r.read_write as readAndWrite, menu.id as menuId, menu.menu_path as menuPath, menu.parent_id as parentId, menu.level, menu.description, menu.menu_key as menuKey, menu.icon, menu.show, menu."rank" from menu_router as menu left join (select srm.menu_id, srm.read_write, srm.checked from sys_role_menu srm where srm.role_id = #{roleId}) as r on menu.id = r.menu_id where menu.is_delete= '0' order by menu."rank"

select array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT unnest(array_agg(distinct t.user_name))), ',') from (select su.user_name from sys_user su left join sys_user_roles sur on su.id = sur.user_id and su.delete = false and su.status = true and sur."type" = 'Cybertron' where sur.role_id = #{roleId} union all select su.user_name from ad_tb_upp_nature_2 su left join sys_user_roles sur on su.id = sur.user_id and sur."type" = 'ADFS' where sur.role_id = #{roleId}) as t

with tmp as (select distinct menu.parent_id from menu_router menu, sys_role_menu srm where srm.menu_id = menu.id and srm.role_id = #{roleId} and srm.checked = true) select srm.checked, srm.read_write as readAndWrite, menu.id as menuId, menu.menu_path as menuPath, menu.parent_id as parentId, menu.level, menu.description, menu.menu_key as menuKey, menu.icon, menu.show, menu."rank" from menu_router menu, sys_role_menu srm where (srm.menu_id in (select * from tmp) or srm.checked = true) and srm.menu_id = menu.id and srm.role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.update:
update sys_role set
name = #{item.name},
description = #{item.description},
status = #{item.status},
update_time = now(),
delete = #{item.delete},
menu_keys = #{item.menuKeys},
is_admin = #{item.isAdmin},
id = #{item.id} and internal = false
UPDATE sys_role SET status = case when status then false else true end, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
